# 工作流说明 / Workflow Notes

## 需要安装的第三方节点

[🤗 H3 的浅空间放大节点](https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler)

```bash
cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git clone https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler.git
```

---

## 模型下载与放置

**H3 浅空间放大模型，放置在 `ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/`**

| 文件名 | 精度 | 大小 | 适用场景 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors) | bf16 | ~691 MB | Ampere/Ada 显卡上最快 |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors) | fp16 | ~691 MB | 速度与显存平衡（推荐） |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp32.pth](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp32.pth) | fp32 | ~1.38 GB | 数值精度最高 |

> 三个文件结构相同，选一个你显卡和 workflow 能承受的精度即可。节点下拉框会自动扫描到它们。

---


### ⚠️ 3D 倍率节点必须配合音视频分离/合并节点

`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)` 因为 H3 latent 里同时含视频与音频，不能直接接原始 `latent`：

```
[LTXV分离音视频潜空间]  →  video_latent  →  [Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)]  →  [LTXVConcatAVLatent]
                                                        │ audio_latent（原样传回）
```

即：前接 `LTXV分离音视频潜空间`，只把 `video_latent` 喂给放大节点，放大后由 `LTXVConcatAVLatent` 把 `audio_latent` 合并回去。

> 其余2个节点（Target Resolution / Megapixels）都不会处理音频，直接接 `latent` 即可，无需分离/合并。



# 工作流说明 / Workflow Notes

## ⚠️ 重要：`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D) 节点必须配合音视频分离节点使用

`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)` 节点**不能直接接在原始 `latent` 后面**，因为 Minimax H3 的 latent 里同时包含了视频和音频潜空间，直接一起放大可能会破坏音频。

正确连接方式（参考截图）：

```
[av_latent]
    │
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ LTXV分离音视频潜空间     │  ← 把 latent 拆成 video_latent + audio_latent
└─────────────────────────┘
    │ video_latent
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ Minimax H3 Latent       │  ← 只放大 video_latent
│ Upscaler (3D)           │
└─────────────────────────┘
    │ latent (已放大)
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ LTXVConcatAVLatent      │  ← 把放大的 video_latent 和原始 audio_latent 合并
└─────────────────────────┘
    │
    ▼
[VAE Decode / 后续节点]
```

即：

- **前节点**：`LTXV分离音视频潜空间`（输出 `video_latent` + `audio_latent`）
- **中间**：`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)`，只连接 `video_latent`
- **后节点**：`LTXVConcatAVLatent`，把放大后的 `latent` 和未改动的 `audio_latent` 重新拼回

---

## 节点参数建议

| 参数 | 推荐值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `model_name` | `minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors` | 按需选择精度 |
| `scale` | `2.0` | 1.0–4.0，常用 2× |
| `device` | `cuda` | 没有显卡可选 `cpu`，但速度很慢 |
| `precision` | `fp16` | 与模型文件对应；想稳可选 `fp32` |

---

## 完整流程示意

```
H3 低分辨率生成
      │
      ▼
VAE Encode（得到 av_latent）
      │
      ▼
LTXV分离音视频潜空间
      │ video_latent
      ▼
Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)   ← 在这里放大
      │
      ▼
LTXVConcatAVLatent
      │
      ▼
第二阶段二次采样/重绘精修
      │
      ▼
VAE Decode → 高清视频
```

> 这个流程跳过了「VAE 解码 → 像素放大 → 再编码」的笨重往返，也避免了对 latent 直接插值带来的鬼影/重影问题。

Use the provided 3x3 storyboard as the exact visual guide for composition, framing, character appearance, environment, and sequence progression.

Maintain the exact appearance of the toddler: chubby rosy cheeks, big curious eyes, tuft of soft brown hair, round face, small button nose, plain white onesie with tiny stars, mismatched socks with the left foot in blue and the right foot in yellow. Maintain the exact appearance of the tiny lime-green baby dinosaur: bright lime-green scales, cream-colored belly, enormous round yellow eyes, small rounded snout, tiny forearms, stubby tail with small darker-green spikes. Both are in a warm morning kitchen with checkered floor tiles, wooden cabinets, a tall white refrigerator, and golden sunlight.

The baby dinosaur is completely harmless, playful, and adorable. It never behaves aggressively.

Continue directly from the previous generation: the toddler has just spotted the milk powder canister on top of the refrigerator and the baby dinosaur is watching eagerly.

Generate a cinematic 15.0-second fast-paced sequence with rapid hard cuts, matching the 9-panel 3x3 storyboard.

Pixar-quality cinematic 3D animation.
Feature-film quality.
Highly expressive facial animation.
Natural body mechanics.
Warm morning kitchen lighting.
Fast-paced short-form editing.
Smooth temporal consistency.

Timeline

SHOT 1 — 0.0–1.5s (Continuous Shot)

Extreme close-up of the tall white refrigerator top where the milk powder canister sits just out of reach.

Push In fast on the canister.

Audio: Tense string pluck.

Hard cinematic cut.

SHOT 2 — 1.5–3.0s (Continuous Shot)

The toddler scampers to the pantry, dragging a small wooden step ladder with determination.

Low Angle Tracking Shot at fast speed.

Audio: Ladder scraping, excited huffing.

Hard cinematic cut.

SHOT 3 — 3.0–5.0s (Continuous Shot)

The toddler climbs the ladder rung by rung while the baby dinosaur watches from the checkered floor below.

Side Tracking Shot at medium speed.

Audio: Small hands gripping wood, creaks.

Hard cinematic cut.

SHOT 4 — 5.0–6.5s (Continuous Shot)

Close-up of the toddler's small hand stretching and finally grabbing the milk powder canister.

Close-up Push In.

Audio: Small metal canister clink.

Dialogue: "Got it!"

Hard cinematic cut.

SHOT 5 — 6.5–8.5s (Continuous Shot)

The toddler hugs the canister and climbs back down the ladder safely, the baby dinosaur bouncing eagerly beside him.

Low Angle Tracking Shot at medium speed.

Audio: Happy bounce, ladder rungs.

Hard cinematic cut.

SHOT 6 — 8.5–10.5s (Continuous Shot)

The toddler sets the canister on the counter and carefully fills the electric kettle with water.

Medium Shot, slow Pan Right following the water flow.

Audio: Water pour, kettle clink.

Hard cinematic cut.

SHOT 7 — 10.5–12.5s (Continuous Shot)

The toddler flicks the kettle on; steam rises as it boils. He scoops milk powder into a wide glass baby bottle.

Close-up Static Shot with steam drifting.

Audio: Kettle boiling, click.

Hard cinematic cut.

SHOT 8 — 12.5–15.0s (Continuous Shot)

The toddler pours the warm water into the bottle and shakes it until the milk turns creamy white.

Close-up Tracking Shot of the bottle.

Audio: Sloshing liquid, bottle cap click.

Final frame:
The toddler holds the creamy bottle, ready to feed the baby dinosaur, as steam rises gently in the warm kitchen.

No flickering.
No morphing.
No inconsistent lighting.

No aggression.

groups.title: Two-stage sampling upscaling - Decoding and create video
